tools.name: github_search_repositories
tools.description: Search for public repositories on GitHub. Returns a list of matching repositories with their stars, descriptions, and owners.

tools.name: github_get_repository
tools.description: Get detailed metadata for a specific GitHub repository, including its description, stars, primary language, and default branch.

tools.name: github_list_repository_contents
tools.description: List files and directories at a specific path in a GitHub repository.

path.description: Path in the repository (e.g. 'src', 'docs/API.md'). Defaults to root.

ref.description: The name of the commit/branch/tag. Default: the repository's default branch.

tools.name: github_get_file_content
tools.description: Retrieve a structured page of raw plain-text file content from a GitHub repository, including line counts and continuation metadata. Use start_line and end_line to continue through long files.

ref.description: The name of the commit/branch/tag. Default: the repository's default branch.

start_line.description: First file line to return (1-based). Defaults to 1.

start_column.description: Character column within start_line (1-based). Defaults to 1. Pass the returned next_start_column when continuing within an unusually long line.

end_line.description: Last file line to return, inclusive. Defaults to 100 lines after start_line and is capped at 200 lines per call.
